svg.aria-label: An order is new until it is paid. A paid order is shipped: it is packed and labeled at the same time, then it goes out. A new order that waits too long is cancelled.
An order is new until it is paid. A paid order is shipped: it is packed and labeled at the same time, then it goes out. A new order that waits too long is cancelled.

ol.li: The machine starts here. Go to New.
The state New. On entry: reserve stock. On “pay”, go to the choice. On “after 7 days”, go to Cancelled. On “edit”, stay in it and start it again.
A choice. If card valid, go to Paid. If else, go to New, doing “show error”.
The state Paid. While in it: notify the warehouse. On “pick”, go to Shipping.
Shipping, region 1: Here it starts. Go to Packing.
Shipping, region 1: The state Packing. On “boxed”, go to the end in Shipping.
Shipping, region 1: This region is done.
Shipping, region 2: Here it starts. Go to Labeling.
Shipping, region 2: The state Labeling. On “printed”, go to the end in Shipping.
Shipping, region 2: This region is done.
The state Shipped. On exit: send the tracking link. Go to the end.
The state Cancelled. Go to the end.

ul.li: Shipping is a state with states inside, in 2 regions that are active at the same time. From any state inside, on “hand over”, go to Shipped.
A filled dot: where it starts.
A box with round corners: a state. Below its name: what it does on entry, while in it (do), and on exit.
A large box with round corners and states inside: a state made of smaller states.
A hollow diamond: a choice; the path that is taken depends on the condition in brackets.
A ring around a filled dot: the machine, or the region, is done.
A dashed line inside a state: its regions, which are active at the same time.
A solid line with an open arrowhead: a change of state. Its label is the event, a condition in brackets, and after a slash what is done.
